title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 77
description: Ten questions on Psalms 77: a sleepless night of trouble, remembering the days of old, and God leading his people like a flock.

questions.text: What did the speaker's soul refuse in the day of his trouble?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "My soul refused to be comforted."

questions.text: What does the speaker say God holds open?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can't speak."

questions.text: What has the speaker considered, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times."

questions.text: What does the speaker remember in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "I remember my song in the night."

questions.text: Which question does the speaker ask in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 asks: "Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?"

answers.text: "Who can stand before the Most High?"
"Where is the God of our fathers?"
"How does God know what we do?"

questions.text: To what does the speaker decide to appeal in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

answers.text: The wisdom of the elders of Israel
The years of the right hand of the Most High
The strength of his own young days
The law written on tablets of stone

questions.text: Whose deeds will the speaker remember, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "I will remember Yah's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old."

questions.text: Whom has God redeemed with his arm, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: "You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph."

answers.text: The sons of Jacob and Joseph
The sons of Abraham and Isaac
The sons of Reuben and Simeon
The sons of Ephraim and Judah

questions.text: What did the waters do when they saw God?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: "The waters saw you, and they writhed."

questions.text: By whose hand did God lead his people like a flock?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says: "You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron."
